text:
Hannah Lee: Hi all, first-week networking weirdness. Installed Okta Gateway and my work laptop shows connected, but I cant SSH to the bastion (10.7.8.9). Odd thing: I also have a third-party VPN for personal dev tools running. SSH just times out. Any pointers?
Ravi Singh: welcome! quick Qs: which OS? do `ip route` (or `netstat -nr`) and paste routes. also stop the personal VPN temporarily to rule it out.
Hannah Lee: macOS 13.1. Stopped personal VPN, still same. `netstat -nr` shows `10.0.0.0/8 169.254.20.1 UGSc 0 0 utun3` and default via my home gateway. traceroute to 10.7.8.9 stops at utun3.
Alex M.: could be split-tunnel policy + DNS/port conflicts from the other VPN client that registered a virtual interface earlier. Also make sure Okta MFA completed after install; Okta sometimes waits for browser MFA to push routes.
Hannah Lee: did a browser re-auth, okta-bot asked for MFA, it said connected but still no SSH.
Ravi Singh: two quick fallbacks: 1) add a host route: `sudo route -n add -host 10.7.8.9 169.254.20.1` 2) check that you don't have a local firewall rule blocking traffic on the tun interface: `sudo pfctl -s all` (mac uses pf). Try the route first.
Hannah Lee: added host route and SSH connected! Thanks.
Alex M.: nice. Regarding the other VPN: even if it's stopped, its route table entries can linger or its adapter might have higher priority. For docs: recommend uninstalling or fully disconnecting consumer VPNs during onboarding. Also note the host-route is a safe temporary fix; infra should investigate if Okta push failed.
infra-bot: Hannah Lee's IAM tag `corp-ssh-access` is pending. Infra reviewers: please approve to enable console SSM sessions.
Hannah Lee: filed the infra approval request in #eng-infra with employee id. One more question  will the host route persist after reboot?
Ravi Singh: host route won't persist. You can add a small launchd script on mac to re-add it, or file an infra ticket. Better: re-auth Okta and reboot after uninstalling other VPN so the proper corp routes are pushed at boot.
okta-bot: Okta Gateway session refreshed for Hannah Lee. MFA confirmed.
Hannah Lee: re-auth + reboot later and routes stuck this time. Thanks all! Adding to my onboarding notes: "If bastion unreachable: stop other VPNs, re-auth Okta, add temporary host route via utun if needed." :tada:
